title: Module invertibility gives sheaf-level invertibility
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and M an X-module [def-sc-invertible-module]. If M is invertible in the sense of AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.IsInvertible, then M has a SheafOfModules.IsInvertible instance.
